title: Combined v4: c004 (guided RL) inside the real 2,400 s budget: exact-output guided sampler speedups + a 1,800 s RL deadline
description: c004 ran 2,657-2,728 s end to end, over the harness's 2,400 s. c005 keeps its recipe and sampling distribution but removes per-row Python and host syncs from the guided decode loop and overlaps the GPU forward with the line checks; an RL deadline at 1,800 s after harness start guarantees the pipeline (300 s pretraining + RL + ~450-560 s eval) fits. Samples stay capped at 192k: if the speedups suffice the deadline never binds.
hypothesis: c004's sampling took 1,519 s against ~1,050 s implied by its token volume; the gap is per-step CPU work serialized with the GPU. Removing it lets most or all of the 192k guided samples fit, keeping most of c004's gain over c002 within the budget.
expected_delta: -40 to +10 vs c004 (a budget-fair version, not an improvement); 170k-192k RL samples; total <= 2,400 s

pretrain.source: 186-claude pretrain.py run on the pod (300 s), seeds 0/1/2; not the saved weights (see c003 relaunch.md)
pretrain.arch: ALiBiGPT 6x384 Peri-LN, 8 heads (4 ALiBi + 4 NoPE), d_ff 1280

config.data: fork 51604b3: train.jsonl cap-6 (retention), 1,500 rl_targets sampled with the harness seed, dev half of transfer (1,108) for eval
config.eval: frozen harness stage_eval: EVAL_K 64, T 0.8, max_new 512; metric = dev solved at L_true >= 7
config.total_secs: 3600 cap; target <= 2,400 s end to end (the harness budget)

rl.sampler: guided.generate: line-level verifier-guided RL sampling (Leon's run-2 guided sampler ported to lean_seq: fork inverse() on the prefix + Leon's LineChecker; rejected segments masked out of the KV cache and resampled; 4 retries per segment, 24 per row, segment cap 400) + compaction + Lean overlap; eval = frozen harness sampler, unguided; c005: same algorithm with the per-step loop vectorized and the forward overlapped with the line checks (outputs identical to c004's sampler on CPU tests)
rl.deadline: no new RL round once it would end past 1,800 s from harness start (eval takes 413-556 s, so the whole pipeline incl. 300 s pretraining fits 2,400 s)
